desc:
A social media monthly report and insights summary explains what happened on your channels and what to do next. Ecom Swift LLC pulls the numbers from your own accounts and writes them up in plain words, ending with clear actions.

## Why raw numbers do not help on their own

Every social channel has a dashboard, and most of them show a wall of charts. Reach, impressions, saves, shares, profile visits and follower counts all sit side by side, with little explanation. Business owners often look once, feel unsure what matters and close the page.

A report is different from a dashboard because it interprets. It tells you which post performed best, which fell short, what changed since last month and what is worth trying next. That turns data into decisions, which is the only reason to collect it.

## What is a social media monthly report?

A social media monthly report is a written summary of how your accounts performed during one month, compared with the period before. It covers reach, engagement, follower change, link clicks and top and bottom posts, then explains the results and recommends next steps.

## How reporting improves content and spending

Reports show patterns that are easy to miss while posting day to day. You may find that short videos reach more people than photos, that Tuesday evenings work better than Friday mornings, or that posts about a certain product bring visits to your website. Once you see this, you can make more of what works and stop spending time on what does not.

Reporting also protects your budget. If you pay for design, video or boosts, a report shows whether those efforts changed anything. A report cannot create results on its own, and numbers can vary for reasons outside your control, such as seasonality or platform changes. It gives you an honest view so your next month is better informed.

## What a clear report includes

- Reach, engagement and follower change for each channel.
- Link clicks to your website, where the channel provides them.
- The best and weakest posts, with a short explanation of why.
- A comparison with the previous month.
- Results by post type, such as photo, carousel, video or story.
- The days and times your audience is most active.
- Audience details such as age range, place and activity, where available.
- A comparison with a few similar accounts, in higher packages.
- A short list of next steps, written as actions.
- A plan for the following month's content in the fullest package.

## What we do

We collect data from the native insights of each channel, using the access you grant. We check the figures for oddities, such as a one-off spike from a single post. Then we organize them into a short report with plain explanations beside each chart.

The Basic package covers one channel for one month, with the top and bottom posts and a few next steps. The Standard package covers several channels, post type results, timing and link clicks. The Premium package adds audience insight, a competitor view, a plan for the next month and a review call to walk through it together. You can add a second month, an extra channel or a slide summary for sharing with a team.

## Do and avoid

**Do:**
- Decide in advance what you want the posts to achieve.
- Compare like with like, such as month against month.
- Look at saves, shares and clicks, not only likes.
- Act on at least one next step before the next report.
- Keep reports so you can see long-term trends.

**Avoid:**
- Judging success by follower count alone.
- Changing strategy after a single bad post.
- Comparing yourself with accounts of a very different size.
- Ignoring audience details that show who actually follows you.
- Collecting reports and never acting on them.

## Who this is for

This service suits an owner who posts regularly but has no idea whether it is working. It suits a business that pays a freelancer for content and wants a neutral view of results. It also suits a team preparing a budget meeting that needs a short, clear summary.

## What we need from you

We need view-level access to the insights for each channel, such as analyst or similar roles where the platform offers them. We never need your password. Please also tell us your goals, any campaigns that ran during the month and any posts you consider important. If paid results are part of your plan, say so and we will explain what can be included.
